scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run --cwd packages/runtime build && bun run --cwd packages/plugin build && bun run --cwd packages/generator build
scripts.check: bun run check:version && bun run build && tsc -p packages/runtime --pretty false --noEmit && tsc -p packages/plugin --pretty false --noEmit && tsc -p packages/generator --pretty false --noEmit
